projects.name: Mandates & Payment Platform (NACH, UPI Autopay, APBS)
details: Responsibilities
• Led end-to-end requirement gathering for NPCI payment platforms supporting
NACH, UPI Autopay, e-Mandate, Paper Mandates and Aadhaar-based services.
• Managed complete mandate lifecycle including onboarding, validation, execution,
reconciliation and exception handling.
• Prepared BRD, FRD/FSD, solution scope documents and business process flows
aligned with NPCI and banking regulations.
• Designed inward and outward payment flows covering authentication, settlement,
consent management and reversals.
• Used Python (Pandas) along with SQL to perform payment data validation, reconcile
transaction datasets, automate data quality checks, and generate analytical
datasets for Power BI reporting and business insight
• Coordinated with banks, NPCI and internal stakeholders during UAT, certification,
audit readiness and production deployment.
• Supported onboarding of more than 1 million payment records, achieving 99%+
mandate success rate after go-live.

subscriptions.

• Prepared functional documentation.
• Extracted customer data using SQL.
• Exported database records into CSV for analytical processing.
• Built Power BI dashboards.
• Used Python for data analysis and insight generation.
• Supported testing and solution implementation.
Tools Used
• SQL
• Python
• Power BI
• Google Docs
